items.t: Timing chain tensioner can fail
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides
items.note: Engine damage after a chain jump costs far more than this preventive job.

items.t: Intake manifold fails early
items.job: Replace intake manifold

items.t: Water pump housing cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing assembly

items.t: Ignition coils fail and cause misfires or stalling
items.job: Replace ignition coils and spark plugs

items.t: Engine speed can rise unexpectedly
items.job: Update engine control module software
items.note: Free under recall 08V-235. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Exterior light fuse holder can melt
items.job: Replace exterior light fuse and repair holder
items.note: Free under recall 13V-569. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine can stall on winter-blend fuel
items.job: Update engine software for fuel pump pressure
items.note: Free under recall 14V-441. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering wheel clock spring can tear and disable the airbag
items.job: Install clock spring cover or replace clock spring
items.note: Free under recall 15V-483. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Seat-mounted side airbag inflator can rupture
items.job: Replace seat side airbag modules
items.note: Free under recall 16V-045. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Airbag control module can fail
items.job: Update or replace airbag control module
items.note: Free under recall 19V-535. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear child door locks can switch off
items.job: Inspect and replace rear door locks
items.note: Free under recall 16V-464. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front ball joint nut may be loose
items.job: Replace front lower ball joint nuts
items.note: Free under recall 18V-324. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Sunroof ambient lighting can short circuit
items.job: Disconnect or replace sunroof ambient light LED module
items.note: Free under recall 18V-467. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering rack mounting bolt can corrode and break
items.job: Replace steering rack mounting bolt
items.note: Free under recall 26V-590. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear coil springs can break
items.job: Replace both rear coil springs
items.note: Free under recall 19V-188. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Panoramic sunroof leaks water into the cabin
items.job: Clear and reseal sunroof drains
items.note: Water-damaged trim or electronics add to the job.

items.t: Rear hatch spoiler can come loose
items.job: Replace rear hatch spoiler
items.note: Free under recall 22V-226. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat frame may be poorly welded
items.job: Inspect and replace front seatback frames
items.note: Free under recall 20V-505. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear suspension knuckles can crack
items.job: Inspect and replace rear suspension knuckles
items.note: Free under recall 22V-176. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake pipe nut can be loose and leak fluid
items.job: Inspect and tighten brake pipe fitting; bleed brakes
items.note: Free under recall 21V-853. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera image may not appear
items.job: Update infotainment or camera control software
items.note: Free under recall 20V-716 / 22V-514 / 25V-082 / 26V-321. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front passenger airbag can be switched off by a wiring fault
items.job: Repair passenger occupant detection wiring harness
items.note: Free under recall 25V-854. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear tie rod bolt may be loose
items.job: Replace rear axle tie rod bolt and check alignment
items.note: Free under recall 25V-526. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wrong driver airbag may be fitted
items.job: Replace steering wheel and driver airbag module
items.note: Free under recall 18V-102. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear shock absorber mount can break away
items.job: Replace rear shock absorber
items.note: Free under recall 18V-262. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front passenger airbag may tear when it deploys
items.job: Replace front passenger airbag module
items.note: Free under recall 18V-375. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat belt webbing can tear in a crash
items.job: Replace front seat belt assembly
items.note: Free under recall 20V-724. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tire pressure warning may not come on
items.job: Update tire pressure monitor software
items.note: Free under recall 22V-815. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Body control module can reset and stall the engine
items.job: Update body control module software
items.note: Free under recall 26V-587. Check the VIN first.
